sentences.text:
Bench: Debangsu Basak 21.03.2023 Serial no. 20 [Dd] (Anticipatory Bail) (Allowed) CRM (A) 1152 of 2023 In re : An Application for Anticipatory Bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Belur Police Station Case No. 48 of 2022 dated 25.02.2022 under Sections 498A/406/323/325/308/500/506/34 of the IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, corresponding to G.R. No. 1244 of 2022.
-And- In the matter of : Bharat Mishra & Anr.
... ... Petitioners
Mr. Debasish Kar, Mr. Amanul Islam, Mr. Sourav Mukherjee, Advocate

For the Petitioners Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherjee, ld. PP Mr. Partha Pratim Das, Ms. Eshita Dutta,
Advocates ... ...For the State Police filed charge sheet.
The husband was granted bail by the jurisdictional Court.
Considering such aspect and considering the materials in the case diary, we are inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest the petitioners shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) each, with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also be subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and on further condition that the petitioners shall appear on every date before the jurisdictional Court on and from the date fixed for appearance of the accused and in default the jurisdictional Court will pass appropriate order to secure the presence of the petitioners in Court including cancelling the anticipatory bail granted without further reference to this Court.
Prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners is allowed.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
